args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 — Summary
args.body:
- Temperature excursions in cold-chain logistics fell 30% when carriers shared live sensor data in real time.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than from reduced spoilage itself.
- Companion piece notes that pilot programs using this approach cut claims by about a quarter (25%).

Source: blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain + insights.ironbark.example/cold-chain/companion
